optionTypeForm.name: Grafana - Connect Morpheus
optionTypeForm.description: Order form of the Grafana - Connect Morpheus catalog item

options.helpBlock: A Grafana ordered from the Grafana catalog item.
Needed on the first run for this Grafana; stored in Cypher and reused when left empty.
Prometheus as Grafana reaches it (kube-prometheus default shown). Empty = no Kubernetes Pods dashboard; a URL that does not answer is skipped.
Morpheus address Grafana should call, e.g. the load balancer or the single node name. Empty = this appliance's URL.
Read-only Morpheus API user Grafana uses. Created if missing; an existing user is reused, never duplicated.
Optional. Empty: a random password for a new user, no change for an existing one. Typed: set on the user and stored in Cypher.
How long the reader API token stays valid. Order this item again before it expires.
